method: ENABLE, Moby's crosswd.txt and crswd-d.txt, and the English Speller Database's scowl.txt to size 85 (SOURCES.md, pinned by SHA-256), through normalize, each word kept with every proper spelling its sources hold, lower-case; a to z, 3 letters or more; no proper nouns, abbreviations, possessives, word parts or misspellings; every SCOWL group holding a listed word, a word in data/dictionary-drop.json, or an offensive or vulgar note is out, but for the words in data/dictionary-allow.json; a word on a line of size 35 or less is marked everyday
